description: This Java class implements persistence operations for MongoDB related to 'thing search' updates, including retrieving policy reference tags, outdated thing IDs, and purging data within a namespace.

classes.name: MongoThingsSearchUpdaterPersistence
classes.description: MongoDB-specific implementation of persistence operations for thing search updates, including methods to retrieve policy reference tags, outdated thing IDs, and to purge data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of MongoThingsSearchUpdaterPersistence with a given MongoDatabase.

methods.name: getPolicyReferenceTags
methods.description: Retrieves policy reference tags for given policy revisions, returning a reactive stream of PolicyReferenceTag objects.

methods.name: getOutdatedThingIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of things that are outdated based on a given policy tag.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Marks all documents in a namespace as deleted by setting a delete timestamp, returning a stream of any thrown exceptions.

methods.name: thingNamespaceFilter
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for documents within a specific namespace.
